title: `control: false` together with MessageType `CONTROL`

source.note: composed: the two spellings of control disagree inside one message, and the MessageType value is upper-case as well. is_control is the OR of the two spellings, so this message is a control message.

input:
{
  "messagetype": "CONTROL",
  "control": false,
  "format": "text",
  "subformat": "english",
  "content": "Please share your data privacy policies."
}

message.content: Please share your data privacy policies.

expect.text: Please share your data privacy policies.

notes: Genuinely ambiguous: a reader who takes §6.3's field as the authority would answer false. The OR is chosen because §5.1.1 reserves the MessageType value independently of §6.3, and because treating a control message as data is the worse failure. Both spellings are preserved in canonical_json, so the disagreement is not silently resolved on the wire.
